about: The spare account, the first the bot played (2026-11-07 and 08). Parties are found on the party screen by their CPs in order (the screen shows nicknames, not species). Trainer names stay out of the repo: data/accounts/trainers.local.json (not committed) maps them to these keys.
notes: Training shows nicknames in our header (.gl1, .gl5): who is out is read from the header's type icons.
Jellicent's Bubble Beam became Ice Beam on 2026-11-08 (a TM).
